description_en: Queries the details of an approval process under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下审批流程详情
name: GetApprovalProcess

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approval process. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
[ListApprovalProcesses](~~ListApprovalProcesses~~): Queries a list of approval processes in batches
parameters.help_zh:
审批流程ID。取值：
[ListApprovalProcesses](~~ListApprovalProcesses~~)：批量查询审批流程列表
parameters.name: process_id

AppUninstallPolicies.description_en: The list of associated endpoint uninstall policies
AppUninstallPolicies.description_zh: 终端卸载关联策略列表

ExternalProcessId.description_en: The ID of the external approval process. If the approval type is 1 (DingTalk approval), this parameter corresponds to the DingTalk process code. If the approval type is 2 (WeCom approval), this parameter corresponds to the template ID. If the approval type is 3 (Lark approval), this parameter corresponds to the approval definition code. If the approval type is 0 (built-in approval), this parameter is empty
ExternalProcessId.description_zh: 外部审批流程ID。审批类型为 1（钉钉审批）时对应钉钉流程编码，为 2（企业微信审批）时对应模板ID，为 3（飞书审批）时对应审批定义编码；审批类型为 0（内置审批）时为空

FieldMap.description_en: The list of mappings between system fields and external approval form controls

DisplayFieldValue.description_en: The identifier of the control in the external approval form. DingTalk approval returns the control label. WeCom and Lark approvals return the value in the "Control type%%%Control ID" format
DisplayFieldValue.description_zh: 外部审批表单控件标识。钉钉审批返回控件标签；企业微信、飞书审批返回“控件类型%%%控件ID”格式
